quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a behavioural finance platform identifying and correcting individual investing biases.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform identifies your personal investing biases - loss aversion overconfidence recency bias - and builds guardrails that correct them before they cost you real returns.
quests.hint: Name specific biases for credibility.
quests.explanation: Naming specific cognitive biases demonstrates understanding of behavioural finance and creates recognition.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a fee-transparent financial advisory platform charging by the hour with no asset management fees.
quests.correctAnswer: Our advisors charge by the hour with zero asset fees - so their advice is genuinely in your interest not shaped by what earns them the most commission.
quests.hint: Lead with the incentive alignment as the core argument.
quests.explanation: Incentive misalignment is the central distrust issue in financial advice - addressing it directly is compelling.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a global multi-currency account for freelancers working with international clients.
quests.correctAnswer: Our account holds thirty currencies simultaneously and converts between them at interbank rates with zero transaction fees - the true cost of going global completely eliminated.
quests.hint: Lead with the interbank rate and zero fee combination.
quests.explanation: Interbank rates plus zero fees is the maximum possible saving on currency conversion - verifiable and concrete.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a robo-advisory platform specialising in sustainable impact investing portfolios.
quests.correctAnswer: Our robo-advisor builds fully diversified impact portfolios aligned to your specific values - returns and impact measured transparently together in every report.
quests.hint: Lead with values alignment and dual measurement.
quests.explanation: Measuring returns and impact together addresses the false trade-off perception that still prevents mainstream ESG adoption.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a private equity access platform allowing sophisticated retail investors to co-invest.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform gives sophisticated retail investors co-investment access alongside institutional funds - deal flow and terms that were previously available by invitation only.
quests.hint: Lead with the previously invitation-only access.
quests.explanation: Accessing previously closed deal flow is the core democratisation pitch in private equity.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a thematic ETF platform enabling portfolios built around emerging macro trends.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform lets investors build thematic portfolios around macro trends - AI adoption ageing demographics energy transition - rather than passive index tracking.
quests.hint: Use specific trend examples.
quests.explanation: Named macro trends make the thematic pitch concrete and immediately relatable to informed investors.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a parametric travel insurance that pays automatically when flights are delayed.
quests.correctAnswer: Our travel insurance automatically pays a preset amount the moment your flight delay reaches two hours - no claim form no dispute and no waiting.
quests.hint: Lead with the claim-free automatic payment.
quests.explanation: Claim-free automatic payment is the fundamental reimagination of insurance and is highly memorable.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a climate risk insurance for farmers using satellite data to trigger automatic payouts.
quests.correctAnswer: Our crop insurance uses satellite data to trigger automatic payouts when rainfall drops below a threshold - farmers are paid before their crops fail not after.
quests.hint: Lead with the before-failure payment as the innovation.
quests.explanation: Paying before failure rather than after is a profound improvement in insurance design for agricultural losses.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a cyber insurance platform using real-time security posture data for dynamic pricing.
quests.correctAnswer: Our cyber insurance prices policies in real time based on your actual security posture - better security means lower premiums rewarded automatically every month.
quests.hint: Lead with the security-incentivised pricing innovation.
quests.explanation: Pricing insurance to incentivise better security behaviour aligns insurer and insured interests.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an embedded lending platform letting e-commerce brands offer buy-now-pay-later.
quests.correctAnswer: Our embedded lending API lets any e-commerce brand offer flexible buy-now-pay-later at checkout with a single integration - increasing conversion by twenty-five per cent on average.
quests.hint: Lead with the single integration and specific conversion lift.
quests.explanation: Single integration combined with a specific conversion improvement makes the ROI case immediate.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an open banking platform aggregating financial data from every account a customer holds.
quests.correctAnswer: Our open banking platform gives consumers one real-time view of every account card and pension they hold - complete financial clarity from a single screen.
quests.hint: Lead with the complete clarity in one view.
quests.explanation: Complete financial clarity in one place is the universal desire that open banking promises and rarely delivers.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a central bank digital currency infrastructure provider for emerging market governments.
quests.correctAnswer: Our CBDC infrastructure enables emerging market governments to launch digital currencies that provide financial inclusion to populations without any bank accounts.
quests.hint: Lead with the unbanked inclusion mission.
quests.explanation: Financial inclusion for unbanked populations is both a social mission and a massive market opportunity.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI wealth management platform for clients with complex cross-border assets.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform manages complex cross-border asset portfolios - coordinating tax currency regulatory and estate planning across every jurisdiction in one intelligent system.
quests.hint: Lead with the cross-border complexity coordination.
quests.explanation: Cross-border complexity coordination is the highest-pain problem in wealth management and the most underserved.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family office technology platform streamlining governance investment and reporting.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform gives family offices institutional-grade investment reporting governance workflows and consolidated performance analytics in a single environment built for their scale.
quests.hint: Lead with institutional-grade capability for family offices.
quests.explanation: Institutional-grade capability designed for family office scale is the premium positioning in ultra-high-net-worth markets.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an alternative asset management platform providing access to art wine and collectibles.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform provides institutional infrastructure for fine art vintage wine and collectibles - full custody valuation and liquidity solutions for the most illiquid assets.
quests.hint: Lead with institutional infrastructure for non-traditional assets.
quests.explanation: Institutional infrastructure applied to alternative assets bridges passion investments and serious portfolio management.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a DeFi yield optimiser automatically allocating stablecoins across protocols for maximum returns.
quests.correctAnswer: Our yield optimiser continuously moves your stablecoins across DeFi protocols to always capture the highest safe yield - compounding earnings without any manual management.
quests.hint: Lead with continuous automatic optimisation.
quests.explanation: Continuous automatic yield optimisation removes the expertise barrier that keeps most investors out of DeFi.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a crypto tax automation platform for institutional digital asset portfolios.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform automatically calculates crypto tax obligations across any number of wallets exchanges and protocols - producing compliant reports in minutes rather than months.
quests.hint: Lead with the minutes versus months speed.
quests.explanation: Minutes versus months in tax reporting is a dramatic operational improvement for institutional crypto portfolios.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a regulated digital asset custody solution for institutional investors entering crypto.
quests.correctAnswer: Our regulated custody stores institutional digital assets with the same security standards as traditional securities - giving boards and regulators the confidence to approve investment.
quests.hint: Lead with board and regulator confidence as the unlock.
quests.explanation: Board and regulator confidence is the primary barrier to institutional digital asset adoption - addressing it unlocks the market.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a PropTech platform using satellite imagery to value commercial properties in emerging markets.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform values commercial properties in emerging markets using satellite imagery and transaction data - delivering appraisals in hours where traditional valuations take months.
quests.hint: Lead with the hours versus months comparison.
quests.explanation: Hours versus months in property valuation unlocks lending and investment in markets where speed defines opportunity.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a residential real estate crowdfunding platform for build-to-rent developments.
quests.correctAnswer: Our crowdfunding platform lets retail investors fund build-to-rent developments and earn rental income from a professionally managed portfolio - property income without property management.
quests.hint: Lead with the rental income from retail-accessible investment.
quests.explanation: Retail investor access to institutional-grade build-to-rent income is a genuine democratisation of property investment.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a commercial lease negotiation intelligence tool benchmarking terms against market data.
quests.correctAnswer: Our tool benchmarks your commercial lease terms against thousands of comparable recent deals - evidence-based negotiation rather than guesswork for both tenants and landlords.
quests.hint: Lead with the comparable market intelligence.
quests.explanation: Comparable deal benchmarking converts anecdotal lease negotiation into data-driven evidence-based decision-making.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI credit scoring model using alternative data for people with no credit history.
quests.correctAnswer: Our credit model uses mobile phone usage utility payments and social data to score creditworthiness for people with no credit history - opening formal lending to billions of people.
quests.hint: Lead with the alternative data types and the billions unlocked.
quests.explanation: Alternative data credit scoring is the fundamental technology for extending formal credit to the unbanked.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a peer-to-peer lending platform for small businesses rejected by traditional banks.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform connects creditworthy small businesses that banks rejected with individual lenders seeking better returns than any savings account currently offers.
quests.hint: Lead with the double market failure solution.
quests.explanation: Solving two simultaneous market failures - unserved borrowers and unsatisfied savers - is the P2P lending pitch at its most effective.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a revenue-based financing platform for e-commerce businesses that takes no equity.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform advances capital to e-commerce businesses and takes a small percentage of daily revenue until repaid - growth capital with zero equity dilution ever.
quests.hint: Lead with the zero equity dilution.
quests.explanation: Zero equity dilution while accessing growth capital is the most powerful differentiator for founder-led e-commerce.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI tax filing platform for gig economy workers with multiple income streams.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform automatically categorises gig economy income from every platform and files an optimised tax return that minimises liabilities - no manual input required at all.
quests.hint: Lead with the automatic categorisation from multiple platforms.
quests.explanation: Automatic multi-platform income categorisation addresses the specific complexity that makes gig worker tax filing so burdensome.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a real-time tax liability calculator for cross-border remote workers.
quests.correctAnswer: Our calculator tracks exactly how many days you work in each country and computes your real-time tax liability across every jurisdiction - ending unexpected cross-border tax bills.
quests.hint: Lead with the day-counting precision and unexpected bill elimination.
quests.explanation: Unexpected cross-border tax bills are a major anxiety for international remote workers - eliminating them is persuasive.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a corporate tax compliance platform that automatically updates when tax law changes.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform reads directly from your accounting software and prepares corporate tax filings that comply in every jurisdiction - and automatically updates when laws change.
quests.hint: Lead with the automatic law-change updates.
quests.explanation: Automatic law-change compliance removes the biggest ongoing risk in corporate tax management.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a dynamic financial planning tool that models the impact of major life decisions.
quests.correctAnswer: Our planner models how buying a house having a child or changing careers reshapes your entire financial trajectory - so you understand the real cost of every major decision before making it.
quests.hint: Lead with specific life decisions as the relatable examples.
quests.explanation: Naming specific relatable life decisions makes the planner's value concrete and immediately personal.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a retirement planning platform using Monte Carlo simulation to stress-test plans.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform runs ten thousand market scenarios against your retirement plan and shows which decisions keep you financially secure even through market crashes - confidence not false hope.
quests.hint: Lead with the ten thousand scenario stress test.
quests.explanation: Ten thousand scenarios creates genuine confidence rather than a single optimistic forecast.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a financial goal aggregator tracking progress across all accounts in real time.
quests.correctAnswer: Our aggregator connects every financial account and shows your real-time progress towards each goal - so you always know at a glance whether you are on track.
quests.hint: Lead with the on-track visibility as the emotional value.
quests.explanation: Knowing whether you are on track to reach goals is the most motivating and anxiety-reducing feature in financial planning.
